status: draft, root review pending; numerical kernel and source/synthetic checks only; not frozen and no captured-output adapter yet
test_policy: These four RGB-noise output cases remain unopened holdout. Freeze complete method/capture adapter/model identity before one-time evaluation. If outputs guide changes, keep result and classify opened cases as calibration for the revised method/model; register disjoint new test. Dot-output use does not relabel these cases.
source_families: Three Gaussian-correlated scales are mixed. Radial analysis bands are not recovered independent source scales or native physical blur.
mask_geometry: Pixel center x+.5,y+.5. Horizontal nominal capsule: radius half height, centers on mid-y, x clamped between l+r and right-r; strict distance<radius. Insets/outsets change rectangle before radius construction. Rectangles use half-open bounds. No decoded output or recovered alpha used.

rois.context_status: Fixed right-side off-Dock control intended to avoid sparse left text; no proof it is unaffected by native global context/adaptation.
Nominal inset base minus outset selected lens, padded glyph rectangles and padded sparse-scroll rectangle; residual/influence contamination remains possible.
Nominal inset selected lens over base, minus same fixed padded context; do not pool with base material.
Nominal outer capsule minus inset and outset lens and padded context; not measured physical alpha/material boundary.
Context-retaining nominal Dock; foreground/selected lens/text remain. Descriptive composite only, never a clean material statistic.

channels.Ylinear: u=c/255; linearized channel u/12.92 if u<=.04045, else ((u+.055)/1.055)^2.4; weighted .2126/.7152/.0722, normalized units, not measured scene radiance

color_policy: Registered source RGB/profile/hash/pixel hash must match exactly. Future observed adapter must retain original bytes/container/profile assumptions, reject nonopaque input, convert profiled captures through frozen LittleCMS into sRGB without fitted mapping, and explicitly label any unprofiled sRGB assumption. Source-only checker reads frozen sRGB bytes directly.
spatial_statistics: On fixed binary support: source/observed means and population variances, signed covariance, signed zero-lag covariance/sqrt(vs*vo), RMS texture ratio sqrt(vo/vs), raw difference mean and RMS. Means are removed only to define contrast statistics, never to normalize or recolor images. Ratios are not clamped to one.
fft: Full two-sided numpy fft2 of W*(field-muW), W=mask*Hann(height)*Hann(width), muW=sum(W*field)/sum(W). No zero padding, interpolation, registration, frequency/phase fitting, detrending or optimized lag. Energies sum|F|^2/(N*sum(W**2)), cross energy sum Re(conj(Fs)*Fo)/(N*sum(W**2)). Signed spectral correlation Ec/sqrt(Es*Eo); power ratio Eo/Es; RMS ratio sqrt(Eo/Es). These are masked-window finite-field descriptors, not transfer-function estimates.
frequency_membership: sqrt(fx^2+fy^2), lower inclusive upper exclusive. Report full two-sided bin counts, total energy, unbinned low-frequency/DC energy and window diagnostics. At 2px/pt multiply numerical frequency by2 for cycles/pt. Low band has few y cycles in124px height and mask/window leakage. No radial-bin selection from outputs.
undefined_semantics: Any correlation denominator<=threshold gives null correlation plus raw energies/denominator and explicit reason; source energy<=threshold gives null power/RMS ratios. A blank output can give texture RMS ratio zero while correlation stays undefined. Threshold is arithmetic guard, not detectability/quality/acceptance gate.
aggregation: All4 seeds and2 themes reported individually. Native repeat is stability only. Any seed summary is descriptive min/median/max with4 independent source realizations, never spatial-pixel p-values, fitted uncertainty or acceptance probability. Do not count ROI pixels/bins/themes/repeats as independent scenes.
capture_adapter_future_requirements: No holdout decoding in this revision. Root must review and freeze complete method+adapter+candidate/model identity first.
Use native index exact750x1334 world and independently recorded source identity/theme; preserve REST+repeat.

Use Android result geometry source.screen_rect_px and unit local_to_screen basis; require750x1334 at2px/pt and integer world origin; crop only those metadata coordinates. No appearance alignment, resizing or one-pixel optimization.
Require REST, selected0, pointer_up and passed Window/display readiness; preserve actual theme/material observations separately from requested theme. Do not infer private adaptation state.
Read historical baseline/candidate outputs from corresponding captured identity, not modified current working source. Changing candidate requires separately registered captures; no recapture here.
Report source→each output and nativeREST→nativeRepeat separately; cross-system native/candidate comparison only descriptive fixed-coordinate composite, no physical inversion.
Hash and preserve all inputs and decode diagnostics in future run receipt; no overwrites.
limits: No native thickness,IOR,blur,alpha or compositor implementation inversion.
No physical cross-system transmittance, material equivalence, per-millisecond equality or UI acceptance score.
Fixed padded foreground/context masks do not bound optical blur/refraction influence, and native/Android glyph/scroll contexts differ. No clean control-free paired native context.
Private native material adaptation is unobserved; observed public themes are not adaptation equivalence.

Finite masked FFT has leakage; nonstationary warp, occlusion, tint and foreground can change energy/correlation. An energy decrease is not uniquely blur; a negative correlation is not necessarily physical inversion.
Noise sources are designed finite seeded fields, not representative natural backgrounds.
No source,output,frequency,ROI or seed selection after decoding. Preserve negative/ambiguous/null/failed rows.
